business_problem: Bank of America wanted to help customer service representatives resolve client needs faster, navigate complex topics more easily, and deliver more personalized guidance during live client conversations without removing human judgment from the service process.
solution_summary: Bank of America enhanced EricaAssist, its in-house human-assisted AI agent for customer service representatives, by adding generative AI capabilities that operate during live client calls. In the workflow described, EricaAssist ingests the immediate conversation context along with relationship-specific context such as the employee’s role and the client’s relationship with the bank. It then processes that context in real time to summarize why the client is calling, pull together relevant information, and recommend next steps without interrupting the conversation flow. The output is served directly to employees as contextual guidance in under three seconds, so representatives can keep listening, explain solutions, and make decisions faster. The page does not name separate storage or model-serving products, but it does emphasize governance: the system is deployed with human oversight, transparency, accountability, and the employee kept at the center of each outcome.

business_outcome: The enhanced EricaAssist helps employees resolve client needs faster, supports decision making in real time, reduces call times, and improves efficiency and client experience while maintaining human oversight.
